summary: AstroFarm Mars is an interactive space-farming game that explores the challenges of growing food on Mars. Players experience the idea of building and managing a farm in an environment very different from Earth, where resources are limited and successful food production is essential. Our project connects gaming with real-world space exploration by introducing the importance of sustainable agriculture for future missions to Mars. AstroFarm Mars addresses the challenge of imagining how humans could support long-term missions beyond Earth. By turning this complex topic into an interactive experience, we aim to make space science more engaging by focusing on resource management, food sustainability, and the future of human evolution. This project is important because growing food in space could help astronauts become more self-sufficient and bring humanity one step closer to establishing a sustainable presence on another planet. We also provide challenging what-ifs from habitat settings different from Earth; providing limited and easily run-out materials makes the difficulty harder than it should be and prompts greater strategic thinking in order to successfully beat the game.
details: AstroFarm Mars is an interactive farming simulation game that explores the challenges of growing food and sustaining human life on Mars. Players experience what it's like to manage a farm in a Martian environment, where resources are limited, and planning is essential for successful crop production. Through gameplay, users can explore the challenges future astronauts may face when trying to produce their own food on another planet. The project benefits players by making space exploration, agriculture, and sustainability more engaging and easier to understand. Rather than simply reading about life on Mars, players can interact with a simulated farming environment and think critically about how humans could survive beyond Earth. Our intended impact is to encourage interest in STEM, raise awareness about sustainable food production, and inspire curiosity about future space missions. We used Replit to develop and build the game, with web development technologies. No specialized hardware or machine-learning model was required for the project, just an idea, research, and good prompts that can help make a successful game. What makes AstroFarm Mars creative is its combination of gaming, agriculture, and space exploration. It turns real-world strategic challenges into an interactive experience. During development, we considered accessibility, desktop and mobile compatibility, gameplay, adding visuals for better representation of the statistics in each sol, resource limitations, and how to make the concept educational while still enjoyable. The game is very enjoyable and very difficult, so it tempts users to want to keep playing and progressing until victory is an option.
